top_stories.title: Critical Microsoft Entra ID vulnerability exploited in the wild (CVE-2026-69836)
top_stories.summary: Microsoft has patched a critical remote code execution vulnerability (CVE-2026-69836) in Microsoft Entra ID, its cloud identity service, with a maximum CVSS score of 10.0 that is being actively exploited in the wild. The vulnerability, discovered by Microsoft Principal Security Engineer Robert Fitzpatrick, allows an unauthenticated attacker to remotely execute code in Entra ID, which controls authentication and access for Microsoft 365, Azure, and connected third-party applications.

top_stories.title: Microsoft patches max severity code execution, privilege escalation flaws
top_stories.summary: Microsoft patched a maximum-severity vulnerability in Entra ID that has been actively exploited in attacks. The flaw involves code execution and privilege escalation within the identity and access management platform.

top_stories.title: Citrix urges customers to fix critical NetScaler authentication bypass (CVE-2026-19490)
top_stories.summary: Citrix has patched a critical authentication bypass vulnerability (CVE-2026-19490) in NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway, urging customers to upgrade affected appliances immediately. The flaw affects NetScaler Gateway, a widely deployed remote access and SSO solution, making this directly relevant to IAM professionals managing authentication infrastructure.

top_stories.title: Microsoft Patches Severe Entra ID Flaw (CVSS 10.0) Allowing Remote Code Execution
top_stories.summary: Microsoft patched a critical vulnerability in Microsoft Entra ID rated CVSS 10.0 that allowed remote code execution. Microsoft initially marked the flaw as exploited before correcting that status to "No" after being contacted for comment.

top_stories.title: Microsoft’s CVSS 10.0 Entra ID RCE Briefly Tagged ‘Exploited’ Before Correction — and What That Reveals About Identity Infrastructure Disclosure
top_stories.summary: Microsoft disclosed CVE-2026-69836, a critical remote code execution vulnerability in Microsoft Entra ID with a maximum CVSS score of 10.0, allowing unauthenticated network-accessible exploitation. The vulnerability was briefly tagged as actively exploited before the classification was corrected, raising questions about disclosure accuracy for identity infrastructure vulnerabilities.

news.title: Hundreds of leaked AWS keys give full control over corporate accounts
news.summary: Over 9,300 AWS access keys exposed publicly between August 2022 and August 2026 remain active and valid. The leaked credentials grant full control over corporate AWS accounts, representing a significant access management and secrets management failure.

news.title: Nearly half of enterprises have no one leading PQC migration
news.summary: New research from Axiad finds that nearly half of enterprises lack designated ownership for post-quantum cryptography (PQC) migration, despite believing they are prepared for quantum computing security challenges. The study highlights gaps in testing and visibility, noting that while 75% of respondents claim to maintain updated inventories of certificates, cryptographic keys, and algorithms, significant readiness deficiencies remain.

news.title: Suspected Russian Hackers Abuse Google OAuth and WhatsApp Linking to Hijack Accounts
news.summary: Three suspected Russian cyber espionage groups (UNC6293, UNC7005, and UNC5976) have been observed abusing Google OAuth authentication flows and WhatsApp account linking mechanisms to hijack accounts. The targets include individuals in academia, aerospace and defense, governments, and think tanks across Europe and the U.S.

news.title: Fine-Grained Access Control Now Available for All Heroku Customers
news.summary: Heroku has released Fine-Grained Access Controls (FGAC) to all customers, replacing its legacy predefined role system. The new system allows individual capability-level permissions rather than fixed permission bundles tied to roles like admin, member, or collaborator.

news.title: Microsoft sounds alarm as perfect-10 Entra ID flaw comes under attack
news.summary: Microsoft has disclosed a critical severity (CVSS 10.0) vulnerability in Microsoft Entra ID that has been actively exploited in the wild. The flaw affects Microsoft's cloud identity platform, and while Microsoft states it has already been patched, the company has not disclosed details about who exploited it or the scope of the attacks.

news.title: N-able Bug Exposes Password Vault Master Keys
news.summary: A vulnerability in N-able's Passportal password manager exposed master keys to the password vault, affecting MSPs and SMBs that rely on the product. The flaw raises concerns about cloud-based password vault architectures, with questions remaining about residual risk even after the patch was applied.

news.title: AWS limits AI agents’ data access, even when manipulated
news.summary: AWS has introduced an approach for propagating user authorization context through AI agents in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, allowing access controls to be enforced at the infrastructure level rather than relying on the agent itself. The system enables downstream services like Amazon DynamoDB and SaaS platforms to apply per-user authorization, preventing agents from returning data beyond what the requesting user is permitted to access.

news.title: Critical NetScaler Flaw Can Bypass Authentication on Certain Gateway and AAA Servers
news.summary: Citrix has released security updates addressing two vulnerabilities in NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway, including a critical authentication bypass flaw. The vulnerability affects customer-managed deployments including certain FIPS and NDcPP builds, as well as SecurAccess configurations on Gateway and AAA servers.

news.title: Why "Shady AI" is Security's Next Big Governance Problem
news.summary: A Meta internal AI agent caused a Sev 1 security incident in March 2026 by exposing sensitive company and user data to unauthorized employees after it posted a response publicly without approval. The incident highlights emerging governance challenges around AI agents and authorization controls, as AI systems access and act on data beyond the permissions intended for human users.

news.title: Cloudflare Workers Spectre Attack Leaks JWT From Co-Located Worker at 12 Bits/Second
news.summary: Researchers demonstrated a remote Spectre-based side-channel attack against Cloudflare Workers that successfully leaked JSON Web Tokens (JWTs) from co-located Workers at 12 bits per second in a production environment. The attack rate is 360 times faster than a similar 2021 demonstration, with JWTs being a widely used authentication credential in modern identity systems.

news.title: jumpserver v4.10.19
news.summary: JumpServer released version 4.10.19 of its open-source Privileged Access Management platform. The platform provides secure access to SSH, RDP, Kubernetes, database, and RemoteApp endpoints via a web browser for DevOps and IT teams.

news.title: Pathlock Recognized as an Overall Leader in the 2026 KuppingerCole Analysts Leadership Compass for Identity and Access Governance
news.summary: Pathlock has been named an Overall Leader in the 2026 KuppingerCole Analysts Leadership Compass for Identity and Access Governance. The report specifically highlights high-risk access governance as one of Pathlock's stronger areas, positioning the company within the converged identity governance and ERP security market.

news.title: Show HN: RecoveryCodes – MFA inventory for auth outside IdPs
news.summary: A developer has launched RecoveryCodes, a tool designed to inventory MFA configurations for accounts that fall outside federated identity providers like Okta and Microsoft Entra. The tool aims to map root accounts, registrars, banks, and vendor portals to their associated devices and recovery codes.

news.title: LoginRadius Global Acquired by Volaris Group
news.summary: Volaris Group has acquired LoginRadius Global, a Canadian enterprise customer identity and access management (CIAM) provider. The acquisition expands Volaris Group's presence in the security vertical and adds LoginRadius's CIAM platform to its portfolio.

news.title: Hackers Compromised 14,500+ Dahua Devices Using Credential Attacks, Auth Bypasses, and P2P
news.summary: Hackers compromised over 14,530 Dahua surveillance devices between June 17 and July 22, 2026, using credential attacks, two authentication-bypass vulnerabilities, and a P2P relay technique. The campaign, dubbed Operation CameraSwarm, was uncovered by Hunt.io researchers who analyzed a 407 MB exposed working directory containing 2,616 files.

news.title: Cyera's Oasis Security Buy Is All About AI Agent Control
news.summary: Cyera acquired Oasis Security in a $1 billion deal to converge data security and identity management into a single control plane. The acquisition redefines privileged access management around business context rather than static roles, with a focus on controlling AI agent identities.

news.title: Canadian Man Pleads Guilty in Snowflake Extortions
news.summary: Connor Riley Moucka, a 26-year-old Canadian, pleaded guilty to computer fraud and conspiracy charges related to hacking and extorting over 165 organizations using Snowflake's cloud data storage platform. The attacks resulted in the theft of data including over 100 million AT&T customer call and text records.

news.title: Lessons Learned from CISA’s Recent GitHub Leak
news.summary: CISA released a postmortem report on a data breach in which a contractor accidentally exposed dozens of internal CISA credentials, including AWS GovCloud keys, in a public GitHub repository for nearly six months. The incident highlights credential management failures and secret sprawl risks, with security experts drawing lessons applicable to IAM and secrets management practices across organizations.

news.title: Scattered Spider Hackers Plead Guilty on Day 1 of Trial
news.summary: Two Scattered Spider members pleaded guilty in the UK to charges related to the August 2024 cyberattack on Transport for London. Scattered Spider is known for social engineering and identity-based attacks, including SIM swapping and MFA bypass techniques used to compromise organizational accounts.
